title: shmap-rs 1.6.0: native adaptive long-read mapping experiments
description:
A Rust port of shmap, a sketch-based long-read mapper. The original mapper remains the default. This release adds opt-in native adaptive sampling, compact and persistent indexes, regional dense repeat rescue, batched dispatch, and parallel query parsing. No external mapper is integrated.

The archived native-only experiment at commit 778d519f001d predates the release version bump: 180 measurements on a2 and 60 on galaxy, with matching normalized PAF output across hosts. On 10x HiFi at 64 mapping workers plus two parser workers, adaptive parsing improves whole-run time by 1.66x and 1.89x respectively. Dense indexing and ONT regress; no tenfold gain is demonstrated. Adaptive MAPQ 255 is unavailable, not confidence. The experiment is separate from the maintained suite gate, and its original binary version and measurements are preserved.
